prerequisites: This course is especially suited to students who are able to complete work independently within a mainly online environment and a given framework of time.

learning_outcomes.text: identify the influence of audience on presentation content, style and organisation
create a presentation outline to ensure a clear organisation of contents, including an introduction, body, conclusion and transitional statements
design effective presentation slides that reinforce the message of the presentation
deliver a presentation on a topic related to their field of study in English
analyse their strengths and development areas as presenters in English

syllabus_topics: Analyzing presenter background and experiences as users of English
Establishing personal goals and areas of development
Watching and analyzing presentations to discuss elements of effective presentations
Planning a talk for academic, non-expert audiences by creating an outline (introduction, body, conclusion, transitions)
Familiarization with principles of effective slide design
Applying effective slide design to own presentation
Practicing presentation in small groups and giving constructive feedback
Creating a final version of the talk based on feedback
